subject: general
question: Five years ago, the age of Bali and Geeta was in the ratio 3 : 4 respectively. After ten years, the ratio of their ages will be 6 : 7 respectively. What is the difference in their present age?
solution:
**Given:**

The ratio of their (Bali and Gita) age 5 years ago = 3 : 4

**Calculation:**

Let the age of Gita and Bali before 5 years be 4x and 3x respectively

According to the question

⇒ {3x +15over 4x + 15} = {6over 7}

⇒ 21x + 105 = 24x + 90

⇒ 24x - 21x = 105 - 90

⇒ 3x = 15

⇒ x = 5

The age of Bali before 5 years = 3x = 5 × 3 = 15

The present age of Bali = 15 + 5 = 20

The age of Gita before 5 years = 4x = 4 × 5 = 20

The present age of Gita = 20 + 5 = 25

The difference of their present age = 25 - 20 = 5 years

**∴ The required result will be 5 years.**
